client.business_model: Multi-brand residential HVAC, plumbing and electrical services platform operating across the South Atlantic and Gulf States
client.sponsor_pe_firm: LP First Capital and Trive Capital
client.client_history: Cascade Residential Services LLC (doing business as Cascade Services) was formed in December 2022 through a partnership between private-equity firms LP First Capital and Trive Capital. The platform began with the acquisition of four Florida-based HVAC and electrical contractors and has since grown to encompass 13 brands providing residential HVAC, plumbing and electrical services across several southern U.S. states.
